title: Diffusion-Generated Image Watermarking: A Two-Axis Taxonomy and Three Protocol-Bounded Case Studies
title_zh: 扩散生成图像水印：双轴分类法与三种协议约束案例研究

paragraphs.en: Watermarking diffusion-generated images requires balancing provenance signals with image quality, robustness, and computational cost. This work organizes methods along two axes: insertion mechanism and primary signal-bearing representation, and formalizes a representative z T z_{T} -Fourier pipeline for verification and identification. We then use the taxonomy to structure three protocol-bounded case studies. The first examines associations among frequency integrity, detection, quality, and cropping behavior. The second revisits persistence under seed-linked and seed-independent editing and formulates a scoped Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis without claiming a localized carrier or causal mechanism. The third studies single-shot VAE-latent phase modulation, including its efficiency, regeneration robustness, and robustness–quality operating points. Finally, we separate four content-level attack families from model/pipeline adaptation, propose corresponding evaluation protocols and testable conjectures for parameter-tuning threats, and identify additional temporal extensions for video. These analyses do not establish a universal ranking; instead, they provide a framework for matched, protocol-aware comparisons of watermarking systems for diffusion-generated images.
paragraphs.zh: 为扩散生成的图像添加水印需要在来源信号与图像质量、鲁棒性和计算成本之间取得平衡。 本研究沿两个维度对方法进行了组织：插入机制和主要承载信号的表示形式，并为验证与识别正式构建了一个具有代表性的 z T z_{T} -傅里叶处理流程。 随后，我们利用这一分类体系来组织三项受协议约束的案例研究。 第一项研究考察了频率完整性、检测能力、图像质量以及裁剪行为之间的关联。 第二项研究重新审视了在种子相关与种子无关编辑下的持久性，并提出了一个范围限定的语义印记假说，但未断言存在局部化的载体或因果机制。 第三项研究探讨了单次 VAE 潜在相位调制，包括其效率、再生鲁棒性以及鲁棒性与质量之间的运行点。 最后，我们将四种内容层面的攻击类型与模型/流程的适应性调整区分开来，提出了相应的评估协议和可测试的猜想以应对参数调整带来的威胁，并识别了视频领域额外的时间维度扩展。 这些分析并未确立一个普适的排名；相反，它们为扩散生成图像的水印系统提供了用于匹配且符合协议的比较框架。

paragraphs.en: The rapid evolution of generative AI, most notably text-to-image Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), has democratized high-quality visual content creation. While early defense research focused primarily on synthetic image detection, modern media protection faces a broader challenge: verifying whether content has been misappropriated or altered via prompt-driven inpainting and semantic editing. Traditional pixel-domain watermarks and imperceptible noise injection [ 2 , 5 ] fail in this paradigm. Because diffusion-based editors re-synthesize images using learned generative priors, they tend to suppress subtle watermark perturbations that are weakly coupled to perceptually salient content [ 30 , 22 ] . This vulnerability requires embedding watermark signals directly into the generative process itself.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能的快速发展，尤其是文本到图像的潜在扩散模型（LDMs），使得高质量视觉内容的创作得以普及。 尽管早期的防御研究主要关注合成图像检测，但现代媒体保护面临更广泛的挑战：验证内容是否通过提示驱动的内容填充和语义编辑被不当使用或篡改。 传统的像素域水印和不可察觉的噪声注入方法 [ 2 , 5 ] 在这种范式下已失效。 由于基于扩散的编辑器利用学习到的生成先验重新合成图像，它们往往会抑制那些与感知显著内容弱耦合的细微水印扰动 [ 30 , 22 ] 。 这种脆弱性要求将水印信号直接嵌入到生成过程本身之中。

paragraphs.en: To address this, semantic watermarking has emerged as a promising alternative, with the literature referring to these methods as either sampling-based or inversion-based, depending on the underlying design perspective. These methods embed a watermark signal directly into the diffusion model’s initial Gaussian noise seed z T z_{T} . During generation, the noisy latent is progressively denoised into the VAE latent z 0 z_{0} and finally decoded into the pixel space. Existing approaches manipulate frequency patterns via predefined rules [ 25 , 4 ] , encode payloads while preserving Gaussian noise statistics [ 27 ] , or combine inversion with iterative optimization to embed watermark signals [ 29 ] . By embedding the watermark into the initial noise and propagating it through the diffusion sampling process, semantic watermarking can remain detectable under generative re-synthesis [ 30 , 15 ] . However, this paradigm introduces distinct trade-offs: improper frequency-spectrum manipulation can degrade generation quality, whereas optimization-heavy methods incur substantial computational overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这个问题，语义水印技术已成为一种有前景的替代方案。相关文献根据底层设计视角的不同，将这些方法称为基于采样或基于反演的方法。 这些方法将水印信号直接嵌入到扩散模型的初始高斯噪声种子 z T z_{T} 中。 在生成过程中，含噪潜在表示会逐步去噪，转化为 VAE 潜在表示 z 0 z_{0}，并最终解码为像素空间。 现有方法通过预定义规则操控频率模式 [ 25 , 4 ]，在保持高斯噪声统计特性的同时编码有效载荷 [ 27 ]，或将反演与迭代优化相结合以嵌入水印信号 [ 29 ]。 通过将水印嵌入初始噪声并在扩散采样过程中持续传递，语义水印技术即使在经过生成性重新合成后仍能被检测出来 [ 30 , 15 ]。 然而，这种范式带来了明显的权衡：不当的频率谱操控可能会降低生成质量，而依赖优化的方法则会带来巨大的计算开销。

paragraphs.en: Rather than merely comparing the performance of individual methods, this work examines diffusion-generated image watermarking from the perspective of the conditions under which embedded signals remain recoverable throughout generation, attacks, and detection. We organize the design space along two orthogonal axes, insertion mechanism and target representation space , providing a structured framework for analyzing how design choices shape the trade-offs among robustness, visual quality, and computational efficiency. Within this framework, we clarify how latent-space strategies overcome the limitations of pixel-domain watermarking, identify their remaining challenges, and outline an expanded threat model for future generative media protection.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究并未仅仅比较单个方法的性能，而是从扩散模型生成图像水印的角度出发，考察了嵌入信号在整个生成过程、攻击和检测阶段仍能恢复的条件。 我们沿着两个正交轴——插入机制和目标表示空间——来组织设计空间，从而为分析设计选择如何影响鲁棒性、视觉质量和计算效率之间的权衡提供了一个结构化框架。 在此框架内，我们阐明了潜在空间策略如何克服像素域水印的局限性，指出了其尚未解决的挑战，并为未来的生成媒体保护提出了一种扩展的威胁模型。

paragraphs.en: Our analysis focuses on diffusion-generated static images, covering representative state-of-the-art latent watermarking methods together with foundational pixel-domain baselines for reference. Non-diffusion generative models (e.g., GANs) are excluded from the scope, while video watermarking is discussed only where temporal dynamics extend the image-centric threat model. The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Sections 2 and 3 introduce the proposed two-axis taxonomy and formal system model. Sections 4 , 5 and 6 present three case studies, under their respective evaluation protocols, on frequency integrity and cropping, watermark persistence under generative editing, and the efficiency and regeneration robustness of phase modulation in the VAE latent space, respectively. Section 7 separates attacks on existing watermarked images from adaptation of the model or pipeline, presents evaluation guidance and three testable conjectures for parameter tuning, and briefly discusses the extension to video. Section 8 concludes with key future research directions.

paragraphs.en: Existing literature often conflates embedding mechanisms with target representation spaces, blending labels such as learning-based , initial-noise-based , and pixel-domain onto a single descriptive axis. Such categorization obscures whether two methods share an algorithmic pipeline or simply target the same underlying tensor. To resolve this ambiguity, we establish a two-dimensional taxonomy that disentangles the insertion mechanism (how the signal is embedded) from the insertion representation space (where the signal resides). This orthogonal coordinate system, summarized in Table 1 , provides a systematic framework to map the design space and expose the technical trade-offs inherent in generative image watermarking.

paragraphs.en: The mechanism axis characterizes the operational procedure used to embed the watermark, categorized into three distinct paradigms:
paragraphs.zh: 机制轴描述了用于嵌入水印的操作流程，可分为三种不同的范式：

paragraphs.en: Training-free: Inserts signals via fixed rules or closed-form mathematical transformations (e.g., Fourier frequency modulation) without requiring parameter updates or iterative optimization during embedding.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练：通过固定规则或闭式数学变换（例如，傅里叶频率调制）插入信号，在嵌入过程中不需要参数更新或迭代优化。

paragraphs.en: Optimization-based: Leaves the generative model parameters frozen while solving an iterative, backpropagation-driven optimization over latent vectors or additive latent perturbations to satisfy a target watermark signal.
paragraphs.zh: 基于优化方法：在解决一个由反向传播驱动的迭代优化问题时，保持生成模型参数冻结，该优化针对潜在向量或加性潜在扰动进行，以满足目标水印信号。

paragraphs.en: Learning-based: Trains or fine-tunes model parameters (e.g., the VAE decoder or diffusion backbone weights) or introduces auxiliary neural network modules to implicitly embed and extract watermark payloads.
paragraphs.zh: 基于学习的方法：训练或微调模型参数（例如，VAE 解码器或扩散模型主干网络的权重），或引入辅助神经网络模块，以隐式地嵌入和提取水印负载。

paragraphs.en: Note that these categories focus on the dominant embedding procedure; for instance, a training-free embedding method may still rely on inversion routines for watermark extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，这些类别主要关注主流的嵌入流程；例如，一种无需训练的嵌入方法可能仍然依赖反演程序来提取水印。

paragraphs.en: The representation axis identifies the primary computational stage targeted by the embedding design along the generative pipeline: initial Gaussian noise z T z_{T} , intermediate denoising states z t z_{t} , clean VAE latents z 0 z_{0} , or output pixels. paragraphs.en: The key principle in categorizing a method is not to confuse the representations traversed along the pipeline with the space where the signal is actually embedded and extracted. paragraphs.en: Early z T z_{T} semantic watermarking schemes [ 25 , 4 ] embed watermark signals by modifying specific frequency components of the initial noise vector. However, such spectral modifications often violate Hermitian symmetry in the Fourier domain. As a result, the imaginary components produced after the inverse Fourier transform must be discarded to enforce a real-valued spatial latent vector. This truncation disrupts the frequency integrity of the seed and shifts the latent distribution even further from the standard Gaussian prior. This compounded Out-of-Distribution (OOD) shift degrades both watermark detectability and the visual quality of generated images.

paragraphs.en: Beyond frequency integrity, resilience to spatial distortions such as cropping is essential for practical deployment. paragraphs.en: As noted in Section 1 , semantic watermarks show promising robustness against generative regeneration attacks [ 15 ] . Inversion-based editing such as Prompt-to-Prompt (P2P) [ 10 ] remains anchored to the trajectory linking the source image to the initial seed z T z_{T} . Similarly, diffusion regeneration [ 30 ] can be approximated as traversing this trajectory, since it adds forward noise to the source image to reach an intermediate latent state z t z_{t} before denoising. Because these operations rely on the original latent trajectory, they are categorized as seed-linked . Consequently, semantic watermarks may remain detectable when their structure is preserved in these recovered latent states. However, recent findings show that watermarks also survive seed-independent editing protocols such as InfEdit [ 26 ] , which synthesize images from newly sampled initial noise while retaining structural guidance. This survival challenges purely seed-linked explanations and leaves the precise watermark carrier unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 1 节所述，语义水印在对抗生成性再生攻击方面展现出令人鼓舞的鲁棒性 [15]。 基于反演的编辑方法（例如 Prompt-to-Prompt (P2P) [10]）仍然依赖于将源图像与初始种子 z_T z_{T} 关联起来的轨迹。 类似地，扩散再生 [30] 可近似为沿此轨迹进行遍历，因为它会向源图像添加前向噪声，在去噪之前达到一个中间潜在状态 z_t z_{t}。 由于这些操作依赖于原始的潜在轨迹，因此被归类为种子相关操作。 因此，当语义水印的结构在这些恢复的潜在状态中得以保留时，它们可能仍然可被检测。 然而，近期的研究结果表明，水印在诸如 InfEdit [26] 等与种子无关的编辑协议中也能存活；这类协议通过从新采样的初始噪声合成图像，同时保留结构引导。 这种生存能力对纯粹基于种子的解释提出了挑战，也使得水印的确切载体仍然未明。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows that HSQR and Gaussian Shading retain TPRs of at least 0.98 0.98 under both editors, whereas Tree-Ring reaches 0.25 0.25 under P2P and 0.32 0.32 under InfEdit, as reported in our prior work [ 18 ] .

paragraphs.en: Because P2P and InfEdit differ in algorithmic design beyond seed dependence, their numerical gap does not isolate the effect of replacing the original seed. In addition, detailed evaluations reveal that Tree-Ring already has low detectability on unedited source images, and this performance remains largely unchanged after editing. Since Tree-Ring directly modifies initial latent frequencies without preserving spectral integrity, its embedded pattern forms an out-of-distribution (OOD) signal that fails to align with the natural generative manifold. This structural limitation hinders reliable signal recovery even prior to editing, indicating that its low post-edit performance reflects poor initial detectability rather than edit-induced signal degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 P2P 和 InfEdit 在算法设计上除了依赖种子之外还存在差异，它们之间的数值差距无法单独反映替换原始种子的影响。 此外，详细评估显示，Tree-Ring 在未编辑的源图像上本就具有较低的检测性，且这一性能在编辑后基本保持不变。 由于 Tree-Ring 直接修改初始潜在频率而不保留光谱完整性，其嵌入的模式会形成一个分布外（OOD）信号，无法与自然的生成流形对齐。 这种结构性限制甚至在编辑前就阻碍了可靠的信号恢复，表明其编辑后的低性能反映的是初始检测性差，而非编辑引起的信号退化。

paragraphs.en: Watermarks in z T z_{T} can be robust, but detection requires DDIM inversion and several seconds per image. paragraphs.en: The analyses in Secs. 4 , 5 and 6 evaluate attacks on watermarked images under a fixed embedding and detection pipeline. They do not cover changes to a released model or pipeline. paragraphs.en: Full fine-tuning, LoRA [ 11 ] , DreamBooth [ 23 ] , and Textual Inversion [ 8 ] cannot be placed on a universal severity scale based only on the number of parameters. Any fair comparison must state the exact trainable tensors, objective, data, optimization budget, active embedding components, and detector model. The primary attack evaluation should keep the key, detector, and threshold calibrated on the original negative distribution fixed. Researchers may report recalibration on adapted outputs separately as a diagnostic for calibration shift.

paragraphs.en: Video watermarking introduces temporal attacks that do not occur in static images. VideoShield [ 12 ] extends Gaussian Shading across time with template bits. It reports spatiotemporal tamper localization and temporal position recovery under frame exchange, insertion, and deletion, but extraction still uses DDIM inversion. VideoMark [ 13 ] embeds PRC coded messages frame by frame and uses edit distance for temporal alignment. It addresses inversion error, temporal distortion, and changes in sequence length. Video evaluations should cover insertion, deletion, exchange, and misalignment in addition to the five families above. They should also test inversion drift after temporal adapter tuning.

paragraphs.en: This paper organizes watermarking methods for images generated by diffusion models according to insertion mechanism and representation space. It also formalizes verification and closed set identification for a representative Fourier watermark in z T z_{T} . The three case studies use different evaluation protocols, so their results do not provide a direct ranking. The results suggest a relation among frequency integrity, detection, and image quality, but the comparison does not separate Hermitian symmetry from other design changes. HSTR and HSQR also show higher identification accuracy than RingID in the crop tests. The editing results motivate the Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis, but the experiments do not identify which image features carry the watermark or test the proposed factors separately. PhaseMark requires less than one second for both embedding and detection and records an average verification rate of 0.998 in the regeneration tests. Its modulation methods show a trade-off between detection and image quality.

paragraphs.en: Section 7 separates attacks on an existing watermarked image from changes to the model or watermarking pipeline. Current evidence on adaptation comes from individual methods, so the paper does not rank these attacks by strength. The three conjectures concern component overlap, the relation between generation and inversion, and the effects of adaptation type, objective, and strength. Tests should state which components are trained, keep the key, detector, and threshold fixed, and report generation quality and performance on the adaptation task. Video also requires tests for frame insertion, deletion, exchange, and misalignment. Editing studies should test the same images before and after editing and report conditional retention at a fixed threshold. Adaptation studies should compare settings with similar generation quality and adaptation performance. These questions should also be tested with more diffusion models, watermark families, and video models. The verification and identification tasks in this paper do not by themselves establish legal ownership.
paragraphs.zh: 第 7 节将针对已有水印图像的攻击与对模型或水印流程的修改区分开来。 目前关于适应性的证据来自个别方法，因此本文未对这些攻击按强度进行排序。 这三个猜想涉及组件重叠、生成与逆推之间的关系，以及适应性类型、目标和强度的影响。 测试应说明哪些组件经过训练，保持密钥、检测器和阈值不变，并报告生成质量以及在适应性任务上的表现。 视频还需要针对帧插入、删除、交换和错位进行测试。 编辑研究应在编辑前后对同一图像进行测试，并在固定阈值下报告条件保留率。 适应性研究应比较具有相似生成质量和适应性表现的设置。 这些问题还应使用更多扩散模型、水印家族和视频模型进行测试。 本文中的验证和识别任务本身并不能确立法律所有权。
